industry.recruitment: Online job classifieds in India are a near-monopoly for Naukri in white-collar hiring: 118 mn resumes, ~25,000 added and ~8.6 lakh modified a day, 1.46 lakh billed customers in FY26 (Q1FY27 deck). Competitors are LinkedIn (professional network, strong in premium hiring), foundit (ex-Monster India), Indeed and Apna/WorkIndia in blue-collar hiring. Demand is driven by IT services and GCC hiring (~45% of B2B billings incl. GCCs), consultants (~24%) and other sectors (~28%).
industry.realEstate: 99acres competes with Housing.com/PropTiger (REA Group), MagicBricks (Times Internet), NoBroker and builders' own channels; management estimates the new-project advertising market at over Rs5,000 cr. 99acres' web time-share was 49% and app 55% in Q1FY27 (SimilarWeb).
industry.matrimony: Jeevansathi is number two or three behind Matrimony.com (BharatMatrimony) and Shaadi.com; strongest in Hindi-speaking markets (45%+ profile share).
industry.education: Shiksha (college discovery and study-abroad counselling) is losing referred search traffic as AI answers replace search results.
industry.ai: Management's view (Q1FY27 call): where Info Edge owns both sides of the marketplace and the data (Naukri, 99acres, Jeevansathi), AI strengthens the business; where traffic came through third-party search (Shiksha), AI is a headwind.

street.coverage: Wide (S&P Global counted 21 analysts in Jun-2026, average target Rs1,300). Notes we could read or that were summarised in the press, standing on 30-Sep-2026: ICICI Securities and Motilal Oswal (Q1FY27 result notes, 10-11 Aug-2026); JM Financial, Citi, JP Morgan and Nomura (after the Q1FY27 business update, 7-8 Jul-2026).
street.method: Sum of the parts. JM Financial: Recruitment on P/E (22x Mar-28E EPS in May-2026, raised to 30x in Jul-2026), 99acres 4x Mar-28E sales, Jeevansathi and others 2x sales, Eternal and PB Fintech at market less a 25% holding-company discount, other investees at book, cash. Motilal Oswal: Naukri and 99acres on DCF (WACC 11%, terminal growth 4.5%), Eternal and PB Fintech at market (no discount), Jeevansathi and others 10x FY27E EV/sales, other investees, cash. ICICI Securities: SOTP (components not in the sources we could read).

moat.evidence: 118 mn resumes, 1.46 lakh paying recruiters, 58% segment margin in Q1FY27; no competitor has comparable scale in Indian white-collar hiring.
Realisation per customer rising; price increases and premium products (AI-Rex, Talent Pulse) carried by recruiters.
Traffic leader (~49-55% time-share) but has lost money for years; margins only now turning.
Sub-scale in matrimony; Shiksha exposed to AI search.
Zomato (cost Rs146 cr, worth Rs38,386 cr on 30-Sep-2026) and Policybazaar (Rs568 cr, Rs6,116 cr); Rs673 cr of investments written off or provisioned by Mar-2023.

critiques: AI could shrink white-collar hiring volumes and let recruiters source candidates without Naukri's database (JM Financial, May-2026).
Hiring is replacement-led; mid-tier hiring volumes are weak (management, Q1FY27 call).
Two-thirds of the market value outside Naukri is the Eternal and PB Fintech stakes, which Info Edge has not sold: shareholders get their value only through the share price.
Consolidated profit is dominated by fair-value gains and AIF minorities; reported EPS is not a guide to the operating business.
gaps: ICICI Securities' SOTP components and JM Financial's Q1FY27 result note were not in the sources we could read; Citi, JP Morgan and Nomura targets come from press reports (8-Jul-2026) without method.
Trendlyne says ICICI Securities cut its target to Rs1,500 on 11-Aug-2026; the ICICI Direct PDF of the same date says Rs1,600. We use the PDF.

Info Edge's PB Fintech holding before the Aug-2025 Makesense merger is taken as 5.749 cr look-through shares throughout (2.754 cr held directly, verified Mar-2023 to Mar-2026, plus the 2.995 cr received at the merger for Info Edge's 50.01% of Makesense); Makesense's own PB holding was not verified.
Unlisted investments at book are taken at the Mar-2026 level (Rs2,476 cr, Info Edge's share) for every quarter in the discount history; the earlier quarter-ends were not rebuilt (it is ~3% of value).
Cash (incl. wholly owned subsidiaries) is taken at the preceding March level for each quarter-end in the discount history; Mar-2021 cash was not sourced, so 2021 quarter-ends use Mar-2022.
The Jun-2026 named shareholder list was not in the sources we read; named holders are at Mar-2026.
Standalone quarterly D&A and finance costs before Q1FY27 were not collected; quarterly standalone EBITDA is not shown.
